intro.text: A member of the Liaforan royal family, a Soulcasting savant who joins a voyage to the lost city of Akinah in search of a cure.

items.text: A cousin of the Liaforan prince, Kaza dreamed as a girl of becoming a naturalist, but was assigned a royal Soulcaster that was always to stay in the family. Using it throughout her life, she grew deeply attached to it and became a savant, and the royal family kept her under lock and key, with every comfort she wanted.

Captain Vazrmeb of the First Dreams learned of her abilities and wanted her help reaching Akinah. Drawn by rumours that the city held a cure for savanthood, and angry with her family, Kaza escaped her confinement and joined him.

The ship weathered a strange storm in the Aimian Sea. Near Akinah, Kaza partly Soulcast great rock barriers so the ship's dinghies could approach, but the ship's cook poisoned her and the crew to keep them from the island. Her savanthood let her hold out long enough to reach land.
As the poison took hold and the cook's creatures tried to take her Soulcaster, Kaza gave in to her urge and turned herself and the ground around her into smoke, choosing her own end.

appearance.text: She is past her middle years. Long Soulcasting has left her disfigured: parts of her body, her face included, are turning translucent or vanishing into dark smoke, and she hides this under a hooded robe and black gloves.

personality.text: Her condition has distanced her from ordinary human behaviour; she must remind herself why people talk to her and speaks matter-of-factly about things that disturb others.
Independent, she resents how her family has controlled her and insists she is a person, not a tool to be used.
